questions.prompt: How do you view all devices (including network) attached to an instance?
questions.explanation: lxc config device show <instance> displays all devices, including NIC (network) devices.

questions.prompt: How do you add a second NIC (eth1) to instance 'first' on network 'lxdbr0'?
options: lxc config device add first eth1 nic network=lxdbr0
lxc network add first eth1 lxdbr0
lxc config set first eth1 nic lxdbr0
lxc device add first eth1 network=lxdbr0
questions.answer: lxc config device add first eth1 nic network=lxdbr0
questions.explanation: lxc config device add <instance> <device_name> nic network=<network> adds a new NIC device.

questions.prompt: How do you check internet connectivity from inside an instance?
questions.explanation: Use lxc exec to run ping inside the instance. The -c 3 flag sends 3 packets and exits.

questions.prompt: Select all valid LXD NIC types:
questions.explanation: LXD supports bridged, macvlan, routed, and physical NIC types. Wireless and bluetooth are not LXD NIC types.
